 These Appeals, Coming On For Admission, This
Day, Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice P Sree Sudha
 Oral Judgment

MFA No.6962/2024 and MFA No.6960/2024 are filed against the common award dated 01.08.2024, passed in MVC No.456/2021 and in MVC No.457/2021, respectively by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Court of Small Causes at Bengaluru (for short 'Tribunal').
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as per their ranks before the Tribunal.

3. Heard the arguments of both sides.
3.

On 22.10.2020, five members were travelling in a Car bearing No. AP-03-BA-4404, when they reached NC: 2026:KHC:6530 HC-KAR near Kondaiahgarivooru, there was heavy rain and flood water was flowing across the road.
But the driver of the car without taking any precautions, drove the car into the flowing water.
As a result, car struck in the flowing water.
When the water raised to the top level of the Car, Car slipped and fell into the canal.
The driver came out of the car by breaking the front glass of the car and other two inmates also saved their life.
But the other two persons lost their life by drowning in the canal.
4. The application was dismissed by the Tribunal on the ground that the incident occurred was due to the natural calamity and it is not an accident.

Aggrieved by the said order, they preferred an appeal and during the pendency of the appeal, now the learned counsel of the appellant requested this Court to remand the matter to the Tribunal to examine the eye-witnesses.

5. The learned counsel of the respondents stated that the accident occurred in the State of Andhra Pradesh, NC: 2026:KHC:6530 HC-KAR but without any basis, the application is filed before the Karnataka High Court, in Bangalore Court and thus he disputed the jurisdiction also.
6.

entities.text: Karnataka High Court, in Bangalore Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The matters are remanded to the Tribunal with a specific direction to grant reasonable opportunity to both sides, for adducing evidence and for arguments and to dispose of the matter on merits by duly considering all the entire evidence on record, within three months from the date of this order.
7. This accident occurred in the year 2020 and the petition was filed in the year 2021 and was disposed of in the year 2024, and now he came up with a request of remanding the matter.

Therefore, he is not entitled for any interest from the date of petition i.e., 21.10.2024 till today i.e.,
03.02.2026.
